title: A turn refused stale_fence after a host restart is lost instead of rebound and delivered
outcome: A turn refused stale_fence after a host restart is lost instead of rebound and delivered
acceptance: After a TermAl host restart, a session whose pre-restart work binding went stale has its next prompt delivered (rebinding or released focus), or receives a refusal that names the recovery step; a test reproduces the host_transition plus stale binding sequence

completion.summary: Added deterministic regression coverage for stale work binding after store reopen/host reconnect, actionable recovery refusal, explicit claim recovery/rebind and fresh admission; pinned matching host directive/message assertions. Full gate and fresh Codex/Claude pair passed; independent acceptance passed1/1 with no criterion changes.
